lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I don't know what year it is anymore.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Or the month.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Maybe not even the season.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Time stopped meaning anything after the sky disappeared beneath the dust.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: The air burns my lungs with every breath.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
My skin stings constantly,
as if the world itself refuses to let me forget what it has become.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Even breathing feels like inhaling ashes.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
I haven't seen the sun in...
I don't even remember how long.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: People said the bunkers would save humanity.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: They said we could wait underground until the Earth healed itself.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I wanted to believe them.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
But I couldn't spend the rest of my life hiding
while the world I loved was left behind.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I stayed.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Before the sky disappeared.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Before the silence.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Before everything became so fragmented

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I thought I understood how the old world worked.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I thought I knew what remained solid.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I was wrong.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: The ruins make you realize how fragile things truly are.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
One moment you feel completely safe,
trusting in promises and steady foundations.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
And then, without warning,
the ground shifts beneath your feet.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: *sigh*

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: I don't know what to trust out here anymore.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Perhaps that is the hardest part of surviving.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Not knowing whether you simply misread the signs...

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Or if the safety you felt was only an illusion.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: It became easier to pull back.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
Easier to step into the cold
than to keep hoping for a warmth that isn't really there.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: It felt safer to shut everything out.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: It hurts less than wondering.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
Sometimes I look at the dark entrance of the bunker and wonder
if hiding would have been easier.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text:
But you can't live in the shadows forever,
even if the daylight burns.

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: Sometimes I close my eyes and try to remember what it felt like to be happy...

lines.speaker: DIARY
lines.text: ...continues in cut scene...
